question: ______ is the study of the distribution and determinants of health-related states or event s in specified populations, and the application of this study to the control of health problems.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Epidemiology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Epidemiology** is the study of the **distribution and determinants of health-related states **or events in **specified populations**, and the **application of this study to the control of health problems.**
 
• It is done by **researchers to study a particular area .**
 
• The outcome of the study helps in **controlling diseases**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
